limitations: Retrieve condition-specific masses, foam density, cure and ground support requirements; reconcile unusual phase-attribution wording before using the XRD interpretation.
A laboratory low-strength fill result does not qualify a mine support system or validate modeled environmental savings at another production site.
Selected primary passages only: complete outcome inventories, figures, supplements, sample uncertainty and source-status checks remain incomplete.
Retrieve substrate preparation, dolly geometry, adhesive, coating thickness and test age before comparing numerical bond values.
Cohesive substrate or coating failure is not the same observation as pure interface separation; steel and concrete results must retain their own substrate.
Selected primary passages only: complete outcome inventories, figures, supplements, sample uncertainty and source-status checks remain incomplete.
